baseline.name: member_current
baseline.sql:
WITH target_week AS (
            SELECT
                COALESCE(
                    w."startDate",
                    w."endDate" + interval '1 microsecond' - interval '7 days'
                ) AS "startDate",
                w."endDate",
                l."sport"        AS "sportId",
                l."seasonYear"   AS "seasonYear",
                ss.id            AS "sportSeasonId"
            FROM "Week" w
            JOIN "League" l
                ON l.id = w."leagueId"
            JOIN "SportSeason" ss
                ON ss."sportId"    = l."sport"
            AND ss."seasonYear" = l."seasonYear"
            WHERE w."leagueId"   = :leagueId
                AND w."weekNumber" = :weekNumber
            LIMIT 1
            ),
            member_teams AS (
            SELECT lts."sportTeamId"
            FROM "LeagueTeamSlot" lts
            WHERE lts."leagueId"   = :leagueId
                AND lts."memberId"   = :memberId
                AND lts."acquiredWeek" <= :weekNumber
                AND (lts."droppedWeek" IS NULL OR lts."droppedWeek" > :weekNumber)
            ),
            max_tier AS (
            SELECT COALESCE(MAX(st.tier), 0) AS "maxTier"
            FROM "SportTeam" st,
                target_week tw
            WHERE st."sportId" = tw."sportId"
            )
            SELECT
            gr.id,
            gr."externalGameId",
            gr.date,
            gr."timeTBD",
            tw."sportId",
            gr.broadcast,
            COALESCE(sp.rules, '{}'::jsonb) AS "phaseRules",
            gr."homeTeamId",
            gr."awayTeamId",
            gr."homeTeamName",
            gr."awayTeamName",
            gr."homeScore",
            gr."awayScore",
            (gr."homeTeamId" IN (SELECT "sportTeamId" FROM member_teams)) AS "ownsHome",
            (gr."awayTeamId" IN (SELECT "sportTeamId" FROM member_teams)) AS "ownsAway",
            COALESCE(home_st.tier, mt."maxTier" + 1) AS "homeTeamTier",
            COALESCE(away_st.tier, mt."maxTier" + 1) AS "awayTeamTier",
            (home_st.tier IS NULL) AS "homeTeamUnranked",
            (away_st.tier IS NULL) AS "awayTeamUnranked",
            CASE
                WHEN gr."homeTeamId" IN (SELECT "sportTeamId" FROM member_teams)
                    AND gr."awayTeamId" IN (SELECT "sportTeamId" FROM member_teams)
                THEN 0
                WHEN gr."homeTeamId" IN (SELECT "sportTeamId" FROM member_teams)
                THEN gr."homeScore" - gr."awayScore"
                WHEN gr."awayTeamId" IN (SELECT "sportTeamId" FROM member_teams)
                THEN gr."awayScore" - gr."homeScore"
                ELSE 0
            END AS "rawMemberPointDiff"
            FROM "GameResult" gr
            LEFT JOIN "SeasonPhase" sp ON sp.id=gr."seasonPhaseId"
            CROSS JOIN target_week tw
            CROSS JOIN max_tier mt
            LEFT JOIN "SportTeam" home_st
                ON home_st.id = gr."homeTeamId"
            LEFT JOIN "SportTeam" away_st
                ON away_st.id = gr."awayTeamId"
            WHERE gr.sport           = tw."sportId"
            AND gr."sportSeasonId" = tw."sportSeasonId"
            AND gr.date BETWEEN tw."startDate" AND tw."endDate"
            AND (
                gr."homeTeamId" IN (SELECT "sportTeamId" FROM member_teams)
                OR
                gr."awayTeamId" IN (SELECT "sportTeamId" FROM member_teams)
            )
            ORDER BY gr.date, gr."externalGameId";

Plans.Filter: (("acquiredWeek" <= 13) AND (("droppedWeek" IS NULL) OR ("droppedWeek" > 13)) AND ("leagueId" = 51) AND ("memberId" = 401))
((date >= tw."startDate") AND (date <= tw."endDate") AND ((ANY ("homeTeamId" = (hashed SubPlan 9).col1)) OR (ANY ("awayTeamId" = (hashed SubPlan 10).col1))))

baseline.name: team_current_owner
baseline.sql:
WITH st AS (
                SELECT id, "sportId"
                FROM "SportTeam"
                WHERE id = :sportTeamId
                LIMIT 1
            ),
            ss AS (
                SELECT s.id AS "sportSeasonId"
                FROM "SportSeason" s
                JOIN st ON st."sportId" = s."sportId"
                WHERE s."seasonYear" = :seasonYear
                LIMIT 1

game_season_date.name: member_current
game_season_date.sql:
WITH target_week AS (
            SELECT
                COALESCE(
                    w."startDate",
                    w."endDate" + interval '1 microsecond' - interval '7 days'
                ) AS "startDate",
                w."endDate",
                l."sport"        AS "sportId",
                l."seasonYear"   AS "seasonYear",
                ss.id            AS "sportSeasonId"
            FROM "Week" w
            JOIN "League" l
                ON l.id = w."leagueId"
            JOIN "SportSeason" ss
                ON ss."sportId"    = l."sport"
            AND ss."seasonYear" = l."seasonYear"
            WHERE w."leagueId"   = :leagueId
                AND w."weekNumber" = :weekNumber
            LIMIT 1
            ),
            member_teams AS (
            SELECT lts."sportTeamId"
            FROM "LeagueTeamSlot" lts
            WHERE lts."leagueId"   = :leagueId
                AND lts."memberId"   = :memberId
                AND lts."acquiredWeek" <= :weekNumber
                AND (lts."droppedWeek" IS NULL OR lts."droppedWeek" > :weekNumber)
            ),
            max_tier AS (
            SELECT COALESCE(MAX(st.tier), 0) AS "maxTier"
            FROM "SportTeam" st,
                target_week tw
            WHERE st."sportId" = tw."sportId"
            )
            SELECT
            gr.id,
            gr."externalGameId",
            gr.date,
            gr."timeTBD",
            tw."sportId",
            gr.broadcast,
            COALESCE(sp.rules, '{}'::jsonb) AS "phaseRules",
            gr."homeTeamId",
            gr."awayTeamId",
            gr."homeTeamName",
            gr."awayTeamName",
            gr."homeScore",

            ss AS (

                FROM "SportSeason" s

                WHERE s."seasonYear" = :seasonYear
                LIMIT 1

            SELECT
                gr.id,

                WHERE s."seasonYear" = :seasonYear
                LIMIT 1

                SELECT st.id AS "sportTeamId"
                FROM (
        SELECT selected_membership.*
        FROM "ConferenceMembership" selected_membership

          ON membership_team.id=selected_membership."sportTeamId"
         AND membership_team."sportId"=selected_membership."sportId"

         AND membership_conference."sportId"=selected_membership."sportId"

           OR (selected_membership."seasonYear" IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM "ConferenceMembership" seasonal_membership
               WHERE seasonal_membership."sportTeamId"=selected_membership."sportTeamId"
                 AND seasonal_membership."seasonYear"=(:seasonYear)

game_home_away.name: member_current
game_home_away.sql:
WITH target_week AS (
            SELECT
                COALESCE(
                    w."startDate",
                    w."endDate" + interval '1 microsecond' - interval '7 days'
                ) AS "startDate",
                w."endDate",
                l."sport"        AS "sportId",
                l."seasonYear"   AS "seasonYear",
                ss.id            AS "sportSeasonId"
            FROM "Week" w
            JOIN "League" l
                ON l.id = w."leagueId"
            JOIN "SportSeason" ss
                ON ss."sportId"    = l."sport"
            AND ss."seasonYear" = l."seasonYear"
            WHERE w."leagueId"   = :leagueId
                AND w."weekNumber" = :weekNumber
            LIMIT 1
            ),
            member_teams AS (
            SELECT lts."sportTeamId"
            FROM "LeagueTeamSlot" lts
            WHERE lts."leagueId"   = :leagueId
                AND lts."memberId"   = :memberId
                AND lts."acquiredWeek" <= :weekNumber
                AND (lts."droppedWeek" IS NULL OR lts."droppedWeek" > :weekNumber)
            ),
            max_tier AS (
            SELECT COALESCE(MAX(st.tier), 0) AS "maxTier"
            FROM "SportTeam" st,
                target_week tw
            WHERE st."sportId" = tw."sportId"
            )
            SELECT
            gr.id,
            gr."externalGameId",
            gr.date,
            gr."timeTBD",
            tw."sportId",
            gr.broadcast,
            COALESCE(sp.rules, '{}'::jsonb) AS "phaseRules",
            gr."homeTeamId",
            gr."awayTeamId",
            gr."homeTeamName",
            gr."awayTeamName",
            gr."homeScore",
            gr."awayScore",
            (gr."homeTeamId" IN (SELECT "sportTeamId" FROM member_teams)) AS "ownsHome",
            (gr."awayTeamId" IN (SELECT "sportTeamId" FROM member_teams)) AS "ownsAway",
            COALESCE(home_st.tier, mt."maxTier" + 1) AS "homeTeamTier",
            COALESCE(away_st.tier, mt."maxTier" + 1) AS "awayTeamTier",
            (home_st.tier IS NULL) AS "homeTeamUnranked",
            (away_st.tier IS NULL) AS "awayTeamUnranked",
            CASE
                WHEN gr."homeTeamId" IN (SELECT "sportTeamId" FROM member_teams)
                    AND gr."awayTeamId" IN (SELECT "sportTeamId" FROM member_teams)
                THEN 0
                WHEN gr."homeTeamId" IN (SELECT "sportTeamId" FROM member_teams)
                THEN gr."homeScore" - gr."awayScore"
                WHEN gr."awayTeamId" IN (SELECT "sportTeamId" FROM member_teams)
                THEN gr."awayScore" - gr."homeScore"
                ELSE 0
            END AS "rawMemberPointDiff"
            FROM "GameResult" gr
            LEFT JOIN "SeasonPhase" sp ON sp.id=gr."seasonPhaseId"
            CROSS JOIN target_week tw
            CROSS JOIN max_tier mt
            LEFT JOIN "SportTeam" home_st
                ON home_st.id = gr."homeTeamId"
            LEFT JOIN "SportTeam" away_st
                ON away_st.id = gr."awayTeamId"
            WHERE gr.sport           = tw."sportId"
            AND gr."sportSeasonId" = tw."sportSeasonId"
            AND gr.date BETWEEN tw."startDate" AND tw."endDate"
            AND (
                gr."homeTeamId" IN (SELECT "sportTeamId" FROM member_teams)
                OR
                gr."awayTeamId" IN (SELECT "sportTeamId" FROM member_teams)
            )
            ORDER BY gr.date, gr."externalGameId";

Plans.Filter: (("acquiredWeek" <= 13) AND (("droppedWeek" IS NULL) OR ("droppedWeek" > 13)) AND ("leagueId" = 51) AND ("memberId" = 401))

baseline.name: member_current
baseline.sql:
WITH target_week AS (
            SELECT
                COALESCE(
                    w."startDate",
                    w."endDate" + interval '1 microsecond' - interval '7 days'
                ) AS "startDate",
                w."endDate",
                l."sport"        AS "sportId",
                l."seasonYear"   AS "seasonYear",
                ss.id            AS "sportSeasonId"
            FROM "Week" w
            JOIN "League" l
                ON l.id = w."leagueId"
            JOIN "SportSeason" ss
                ON ss."sportId"    = l."sport"
            AND ss."seasonYear" = l."seasonYear"
            WHERE w."leagueId"   = :leagueId
                AND w."weekNumber" = :weekNumber
            LIMIT 1
            ),
            member_teams AS (
            SELECT lts."sportTeamId"
            FROM "LeagueTeamSlot" lts
            WHERE lts."leagueId"   = :leagueId
                AND lts."memberId"   = :memberId
                AND lts."acquiredWeek" <= :weekNumber
                AND (lts."droppedWeek" IS NULL OR lts."droppedWeek" > :weekNumber)
            ),
            max_tier AS (
            SELECT COALESCE(MAX(st.tier), 0) AS "maxTier"
            FROM "SportTeam" st,
                target_week tw
            WHERE st."sportId" = tw."sportId"
            )
            SELECT
            gr.id,
            gr."externalGameId",
            gr.date,
            gr."timeTBD",
            tw."sportId",
            gr.broadcast,
            COALESCE(sp.rules, '{}'::jsonb) AS "phaseRules",
            gr."homeTeamId",
            gr."awayTeamId",
            gr."homeTeamName",
            gr."awayTeamName",
            gr."homeScore",
            gr."awayScore",
            (gr."homeTeamId" IN (SELECT "sportTeamId" FROM member_teams)) AS "ownsHome",
            (gr."awayTeamId" IN (SELECT "sportTeamId" FROM member_teams)) AS "ownsAway",
            COALESCE(home_st.tier, mt."maxTier" + 1) AS "homeTeamTier",
            COALESCE(away_st.tier, mt."maxTier" + 1) AS "awayTeamTier",
            (home_st.tier IS NULL) AS "homeTeamUnranked",
            (away_st.tier IS NULL) AS "awayTeamUnranked",
            CASE
                WHEN gr."homeTeamId" IN (SELECT "sportTeamId" FROM member_teams)
                    AND gr."awayTeamId" IN (SELECT "sportTeamId" FROM member_teams)
                THEN 0
                WHEN gr."homeTeamId" IN (SELECT "sportTeamId" FROM member_teams)
                THEN gr."homeScore" - gr."awayScore"
                WHEN gr."awayTeamId" IN (SELECT "sportTeamId" FROM member_teams)
                THEN gr."awayScore" - gr."homeScore"
                ELSE 0
            END AS "rawMemberPointDiff"
            FROM "GameResult" gr
            LEFT JOIN "SeasonPhase" sp ON sp.id=gr."seasonPhaseId"
            CROSS JOIN target_week tw
            CROSS JOIN max_tier mt
            LEFT JOIN "SportTeam" home_st
                ON home_st.id = gr."homeTeamId"
            LEFT JOIN "SportTeam" away_st
                ON away_st.id = gr."awayTeamId"
            WHERE gr.sport           = tw."sportId"
            AND gr."sportSeasonId" = tw."sportSeasonId"
            AND gr.date BETWEEN tw."startDate" AND tw."endDate"
            AND (
                gr."homeTeamId" IN (SELECT "sportTeamId" FROM member_teams)
                OR
                gr."awayTeamId" IN (SELECT "sportTeamId" FROM member_teams)
            )
            ORDER BY gr.date, gr."externalGameId";

Plans.Filter: (("acquiredWeek" <= 13) AND (("droppedWeek" IS NULL) OR ("droppedWeek" > 13)) AND ("leagueId" = 501) AND ("memberId" = 4001))
((date >= tw."startDate") AND (date <= tw."endDate") AND ((ANY ("homeTeamId" = (hashed SubPlan 9).col1)) OR (ANY ("awayTeamId" = (hashed SubPlan 10).col1))))

                LIMIT 1
            ),

                FROM "SportSeason" s
                JOIN st ON st."sportId" = s."sportId"
                WHERE s."seasonYear" = :seasonYear
                LIMIT 1
            )

                gr."externalGameId",
                gr.date,
                gr."timeTBD",
                gr.sport,

game_season_date.name: member_current
game_season_date.sql:
WITH target_week AS (
            SELECT
                COALESCE(
                    w."startDate",
                    w."endDate" + interval '1 microsecond' - interval '7 days'
                ) AS "startDate",
                w."endDate",
                l."sport"        AS "sportId",
                l."seasonYear"   AS "seasonYear",
                ss.id            AS "sportSeasonId"
            FROM "Week" w
            JOIN "League" l
                ON l.id = w."leagueId"
            JOIN "SportSeason" ss
                ON ss."sportId"    = l."sport"
            AND ss."seasonYear" = l."seasonYear"
            WHERE w."leagueId"   = :leagueId
                AND w."weekNumber" = :weekNumber
            LIMIT 1
            ),
            member_teams AS (
            SELECT lts."sportTeamId"
            FROM "LeagueTeamSlot" lts
            WHERE lts."leagueId"   = :leagueId
                AND lts."memberId"   = :memberId
                AND lts."acquiredWeek" <= :weekNumber
                AND (lts."droppedWeek" IS NULL OR lts."droppedWeek" > :weekNumber)
            ),
            max_tier AS (
            SELECT COALESCE(MAX(st.tier), 0) AS "maxTier"
            FROM "SportTeam" st,
                target_week tw
            WHERE st."sportId" = tw."sportId"
            )
            SELECT
            gr.id,
            gr."externalGameId",
            gr.date,
            gr."timeTBD",
            tw."sportId",
            gr.broadcast,
            COALESCE(sp.rules, '{}'::jsonb) AS "phaseRules",
            gr."homeTeamId",
            gr."awayTeamId",
            gr."homeTeamName",
            gr."awayTeamName",
            gr."homeScore",
            gr."awayScore",

            ss AS (
                SELECT s.id AS "sportSeasonId"
                FROM "SportSeason" s

                LIMIT 1

            SELECT
                gr.id,

                SELECT s.id AS "sportSeasonId"
                FROM "SportSeason" s

                WHERE s."seasonYear" = :seasonYear
                LIMIT 1

                SELECT st.id AS "sportTeamId"
                FROM (
        SELECT selected_membership.*
        FROM "ConferenceMembership" selected_membership
        JOIN "SportTeam" membership_team
          ON membership_team.id=selected_membership."sportTeamId"
         AND membership_team."sportId"=selected_membership."sportId"

          ON membership_conference.id=selected_membership."sportConferenceId"
         AND membership_conference."sportId"=selected_membership."sportId"

           OR (selected_membership."seasonYear" IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM "ConferenceMembership" seasonal_membership
               WHERE seasonal_membership."sportTeamId"=selected_membership."sportTeamId"
                 AND seasonal_membership."seasonYear"=(:seasonYear)

    ) cm

                  ON sc."sportId" = cm."sportId"
                 AND sc.id = cm."sportConferenceId"

game_home_away.name: member_current
game_home_away.sql:
WITH target_week AS (
            SELECT
                COALESCE(
                    w."startDate",
                    w."endDate" + interval '1 microsecond' - interval '7 days'
                ) AS "startDate",
                w."endDate",
                l."sport"        AS "sportId",
                l."seasonYear"   AS "seasonYear",
                ss.id            AS "sportSeasonId"
            FROM "Week" w
            JOIN "League" l
                ON l.id = w."leagueId"
            JOIN "SportSeason" ss
                ON ss."sportId"    = l."sport"
            AND ss."seasonYear" = l."seasonYear"
            WHERE w."leagueId"   = :leagueId
                AND w."weekNumber" = :weekNumber
            LIMIT 1
            ),
            member_teams AS (
            SELECT lts."sportTeamId"
            FROM "LeagueTeamSlot" lts
            WHERE lts."leagueId"   = :leagueId
                AND lts."memberId"   = :memberId
                AND lts."acquiredWeek" <= :weekNumber
                AND (lts."droppedWeek" IS NULL OR lts."droppedWeek" > :weekNumber)
            ),
            max_tier AS (
            SELECT COALESCE(MAX(st.tier), 0) AS "maxTier"
            FROM "SportTeam" st,
                target_week tw
            WHERE st."sportId" = tw."sportId"
            )
            SELECT
            gr.id,
            gr."externalGameId",
            gr.date,
            gr."timeTBD",
            tw."sportId",
            gr.broadcast,
            COALESCE(sp.rules, '{}'::jsonb) AS "phaseRules",
            gr."homeTeamId",
            gr."awayTeamId",
            gr."homeTeamName",
            gr."awayTeamName",
            gr."homeScore",
            gr."awayScore",
            (gr."homeTeamId" IN (SELECT "sportTeamId" FROM member_teams)) AS "ownsHome",
            (gr."awayTeamId" IN (SELECT "sportTeamId" FROM member_teams)) AS "ownsAway",
            COALESCE(home_st.tier, mt."maxTier" + 1) AS "homeTeamTier",
            COALESCE(away_st.tier, mt."maxTier" + 1) AS "awayTeamTier",
            (home_st.tier IS NULL) AS "homeTeamUnranked",
            (away_st.tier IS NULL) AS "awayTeamUnranked",
            CASE
                WHEN gr."homeTeamId" IN (SELECT "sportTeamId" FROM member_teams)
                    AND gr."awayTeamId" IN (SELECT "sportTeamId" FROM member_teams)
                THEN 0
                WHEN gr."homeTeamId" IN (SELECT "sportTeamId" FROM member_teams)
                THEN gr."homeScore" - gr."awayScore"
                WHEN gr."awayTeamId" IN (SELECT "sportTeamId" FROM member_teams)
                THEN gr."awayScore" - gr."homeScore"
                ELSE 0
            END AS "rawMemberPointDiff"
            FROM "GameResult" gr
            LEFT JOIN "SeasonPhase" sp ON sp.id=gr."seasonPhaseId"
            CROSS JOIN target_week tw
            CROSS JOIN max_tier mt
            LEFT JOIN "SportTeam" home_st
                ON home_st.id = gr."homeTeamId"
            LEFT JOIN "SportTeam" away_st
                ON away_st.id = gr."awayTeamId"
            WHERE gr.sport           = tw."sportId"
            AND gr."sportSeasonId" = tw."sportSeasonId"
            AND gr.date BETWEEN tw."startDate" AND tw."endDate"
            AND (
                gr."homeTeamId" IN (SELECT "sportTeamId" FROM member_teams)
                OR
                gr."awayTeamId" IN (SELECT "sportTeamId" FROM member_teams)
            )
            ORDER BY gr.date, gr."externalGameId";

Plans.Filter: (("acquiredWeek" <= 13) AND (("droppedWeek" IS NULL) OR ("droppedWeek" > 13)) AND ("leagueId" = 501) AND ("memberId" = 4001))

baseline.name: member_current
baseline.sql:
WITH target_week AS (
            SELECT
                COALESCE(
                    w."startDate",
                    w."endDate" + interval '1 microsecond' - interval '7 days'
                ) AS "startDate",
                w."endDate",
                l."sport"        AS "sportId",
                l."seasonYear"   AS "seasonYear",
                ss.id            AS "sportSeasonId"
            FROM "Week" w
            JOIN "League" l
                ON l.id = w."leagueId"
            JOIN "SportSeason" ss
                ON ss."sportId"    = l."sport"
            AND ss."seasonYear" = l."seasonYear"
            WHERE w."leagueId"   = :leagueId
                AND w."weekNumber" = :weekNumber
            LIMIT 1
            ),
            member_teams AS (
            SELECT lts."sportTeamId"
            FROM "LeagueTeamSlot" lts
            WHERE lts."leagueId"   = :leagueId
                AND lts."memberId"   = :memberId
                AND lts."acquiredWeek" <= :weekNumber
                AND (lts."droppedWeek" IS NULL OR lts."droppedWeek" > :weekNumber)
            ),
            max_tier AS (
            SELECT COALESCE(MAX(st.tier), 0) AS "maxTier"
            FROM "SportTeam" st,
                target_week tw
            WHERE st."sportId" = tw."sportId"
            )
            SELECT
            gr.id,
            gr."externalGameId",
            gr.date,
            gr."timeTBD",
            tw."sportId",
            gr.broadcast,
            COALESCE(sp.rules, '{}'::jsonb) AS "phaseRules",
            gr."homeTeamId",
            gr."awayTeamId",
            gr."homeTeamName",
            gr."awayTeamName",
            gr."homeScore",
            gr."awayScore",
            (gr."homeTeamId" IN (SELECT "sportTeamId" FROM member_teams)) AS "ownsHome",
            (gr."awayTeamId" IN (SELECT "sportTeamId" FROM member_teams)) AS "ownsAway",
            COALESCE(home_st.tier, mt."maxTier" + 1) AS "homeTeamTier",
            COALESCE(away_st.tier, mt."maxTier" + 1) AS "awayTeamTier",
            (home_st.tier IS NULL) AS "homeTeamUnranked",
            (away_st.tier IS NULL) AS "awayTeamUnranked",
            CASE
                WHEN gr."homeTeamId" IN (SELECT "sportTeamId" FROM member_teams)
                    AND gr."awayTeamId" IN (SELECT "sportTeamId" FROM member_teams)
                THEN 0
                WHEN gr."homeTeamId" IN (SELECT "sportTeamId" FROM member_teams)
                THEN gr."homeScore" - gr."awayScore"
                WHEN gr."awayTeamId" IN (SELECT "sportTeamId" FROM member_teams)
                THEN gr."awayScore" - gr."homeScore"
                ELSE 0
            END AS "rawMemberPointDiff"
            FROM "GameResult" gr
            LEFT JOIN "SeasonPhase" sp ON sp.id=gr."seasonPhaseId"
            CROSS JOIN target_week tw
            CROSS JOIN max_tier mt
            LEFT JOIN "SportTeam" home_st
                ON home_st.id = gr."homeTeamId"
            LEFT JOIN "SportTeam" away_st
                ON away_st.id = gr."awayTeamId"
            WHERE gr.sport           = tw."sportId"
            AND gr."sportSeasonId" = tw."sportSeasonId"
            AND gr.date BETWEEN tw."startDate" AND tw."endDate"
            AND (
                gr."homeTeamId" IN (SELECT "sportTeamId" FROM member_teams)
                OR
                gr."awayTeamId" IN (SELECT "sportTeamId" FROM member_teams)
            )
            ORDER BY gr.date, gr."externalGameId";

Plans.Filter: (("acquiredWeek" <= 13) AND (("droppedWeek" IS NULL) OR ("droppedWeek" > 13)) AND ("leagueId" = 2501) AND ("memberId" = 20001))
((date >= tw."startDate") AND (date <= tw."endDate") AND ((ANY ("homeTeamId" = (hashed SubPlan 9).col1)) OR (ANY ("awayTeamId" = (hashed SubPlan 10).col1))))

                FROM "SportSeason" s
                JOIN st ON st."sportId" = s."sportId"
                WHERE s."seasonYear" = :seasonYear
                LIMIT 1
            )

                gr."externalGameId",
                gr.date,
                gr."timeTBD",
                gr.sport,

game_season_date.name: member_current
game_season_date.sql:
WITH target_week AS (
            SELECT
                COALESCE(
                    w."startDate",
                    w."endDate" + interval '1 microsecond' - interval '7 days'
                ) AS "startDate",
                w."endDate",
                l."sport"        AS "sportId",
                l."seasonYear"   AS "seasonYear",
                ss.id            AS "sportSeasonId"
            FROM "Week" w
            JOIN "League" l
                ON l.id = w."leagueId"
            JOIN "SportSeason" ss
                ON ss."sportId"    = l."sport"
            AND ss."seasonYear" = l."seasonYear"
            WHERE w."leagueId"   = :leagueId
                AND w."weekNumber" = :weekNumber
            LIMIT 1
            ),
            member_teams AS (
            SELECT lts."sportTeamId"
            FROM "LeagueTeamSlot" lts
            WHERE lts."leagueId"   = :leagueId
                AND lts."memberId"   = :memberId
                AND lts."acquiredWeek" <= :weekNumber
                AND (lts."droppedWeek" IS NULL OR lts."droppedWeek" > :weekNumber)
            ),
            max_tier AS (
            SELECT COALESCE(MAX(st.tier), 0) AS "maxTier"
            FROM "SportTeam" st,
                target_week tw
            WHERE st."sportId" = tw."sportId"
            )
            SELECT
            gr.id,
            gr."externalGameId",
            gr.date,
            gr."timeTBD",
            tw."sportId",
            gr.broadcast,
            COALESCE(sp.rules, '{}'::jsonb) AS "phaseRules",
            gr."homeTeamId",
            gr."awayTeamId",
            gr."homeTeamName",
            gr."awayTeamName",
            gr."homeScore",

WITH st AS (

            ss AS (
                SELECT s.id AS "sportSeasonId"
                FROM "SportSeason" s
                JOIN st ON st."sportId" = s."sportId"
                WHERE s."seasonYear" = :seasonYear
                LIMIT 1
            )
            SELECT
                gr.id,
                gr."externalGameId",

                CASE
                    WHEN gr."homeTeamId" = :sportTeamId THEN gr."awayTeamName"

                SELECT s.id AS "sportSeasonId"
                FROM "SportSeason" s

                WHERE s."seasonYear" = :seasonYear
                LIMIT 1

            conf_teams AS (
                SELECT st.id AS "sportTeamId"
                FROM (
        SELECT selected_membership.*
        FROM "ConferenceMembership" selected_membership
        JOIN "SportTeam" membership_team
          ON membership_team.id=selected_membership."sportTeamId"
         AND membership_team."sportId"=selected_membership."sportId"

          ON membership_conference.id=selected_membership."sportConferenceId"
         AND membership_conference."sportId"=selected_membership."sportId"

           OR (selected_membership."seasonYear" IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM "ConferenceMembership" seasonal_membership
               WHERE seasonal_membership."sportTeamId"=selected_membership."sportTeamId"
                 AND seasonal_membership."seasonYear"=(:seasonYear)
           ))
    ) cm

                  ON sc."sportId" = cm."sportId"
                 AND sc.id = cm."sportConferenceId"

game_home_away.name: member_current
game_home_away.sql:
WITH target_week AS (
            SELECT
                COALESCE(
                    w."startDate",
                    w."endDate" + interval '1 microsecond' - interval '7 days'
                ) AS "startDate",
                w."endDate",
                l."sport"        AS "sportId",
                l."seasonYear"   AS "seasonYear",
                ss.id            AS "sportSeasonId"
            FROM "Week" w
            JOIN "League" l
                ON l.id = w."leagueId"
            JOIN "SportSeason" ss
                ON ss."sportId"    = l."sport"
            AND ss."seasonYear" = l."seasonYear"
            WHERE w."leagueId"   = :leagueId
                AND w."weekNumber" = :weekNumber
            LIMIT 1
            ),
            member_teams AS (
            SELECT lts."sportTeamId"
            FROM "LeagueTeamSlot" lts
            WHERE lts."leagueId"   = :leagueId
                AND lts."memberId"   = :memberId
                AND lts."acquiredWeek" <= :weekNumber
                AND (lts."droppedWeek" IS NULL OR lts."droppedWeek" > :weekNumber)
            ),
            max_tier AS (
            SELECT COALESCE(MAX(st.tier), 0) AS "maxTier"
            FROM "SportTeam" st,
                target_week tw
            WHERE st."sportId" = tw."sportId"
            )
            SELECT
            gr.id,
            gr."externalGameId",
            gr.date,
            gr."timeTBD",
            tw."sportId",
            gr.broadcast,
            COALESCE(sp.rules, '{}'::jsonb) AS "phaseRules",
            gr."homeTeamId",
            gr."awayTeamId",
            gr."homeTeamName",
            gr."awayTeamName",
            gr."homeScore",
            gr."awayScore",
            (gr."homeTeamId" IN (SELECT "sportTeamId" FROM member_teams)) AS "ownsHome",
            (gr."awayTeamId" IN (SELECT "sportTeamId" FROM member_teams)) AS "ownsAway",
            COALESCE(home_st.tier, mt."maxTier" + 1) AS "homeTeamTier",
            COALESCE(away_st.tier, mt."maxTier" + 1) AS "awayTeamTier",
            (home_st.tier IS NULL) AS "homeTeamUnranked",
            (away_st.tier IS NULL) AS "awayTeamUnranked",
            CASE
                WHEN gr."homeTeamId" IN (SELECT "sportTeamId" FROM member_teams)
                    AND gr."awayTeamId" IN (SELECT "sportTeamId" FROM member_teams)
                THEN 0
                WHEN gr."homeTeamId" IN (SELECT "sportTeamId" FROM member_teams)
                THEN gr."homeScore" - gr."awayScore"
                WHEN gr."awayTeamId" IN (SELECT "sportTeamId" FROM member_teams)
                THEN gr."awayScore" - gr."homeScore"
                ELSE 0
            END AS "rawMemberPointDiff"
            FROM "GameResult" gr
            LEFT JOIN "SeasonPhase" sp ON sp.id=gr."seasonPhaseId"
            CROSS JOIN target_week tw
            CROSS JOIN max_tier mt
            LEFT JOIN "SportTeam" home_st
                ON home_st.id = gr."homeTeamId"
            LEFT JOIN "SportTeam" away_st
                ON away_st.id = gr."awayTeamId"
            WHERE gr.sport           = tw."sportId"
            AND gr."sportSeasonId" = tw."sportSeasonId"
            AND gr.date BETWEEN tw."startDate" AND tw."endDate"
            AND (
                gr."homeTeamId" IN (SELECT "sportTeamId" FROM member_teams)
                OR
                gr."awayTeamId" IN (SELECT "sportTeamId" FROM member_teams)
            )
            ORDER BY gr.date, gr."externalGameId";

Plans.Filter: (("acquiredWeek" <= 13) AND (("droppedWeek" IS NULL) OR ("droppedWeek" > 13)) AND ("leagueId" = 2501) AND ("memberId" = 20001))
